_comment: Scripted troubleshooting for Version 1, asked one step at a time. Mock content only. The RAG owner can later supply these from the manuals.
tv-55-oled: Unplug the TV from the wall for 60 seconds, then plug it straight into a wall outlet (not a power strip) and press the power button on the TV itself.
Check that the power cable is pushed fully into the back of the TV, and try a different wall outlet that you know works.
Look at the small standby light on the bottom edge of the TV. Is it off, red, or blinking? Hold the power button on the TV for 10 seconds.
soundbar-200: Unplug the soundbar for 30 seconds, plug it back in, and press the power button on the soundbar.
Check that the input on the soundbar matches the cable you are using (HDMI ARC, optical or Bluetooth).
Reset the soundbar by holding the power and volume-down buttons together for 5 seconds.
headphones-x: Charge the headphones for at least 15 minutes, then turn them on.
Turn Bluetooth on for your phone or computer, and remove (forget) Wireless Headphones X from its Bluetooth list if it is already there.
Hold the power button on the headphones for 7 seconds until the light flashes blue and red (pairing mode), then select Wireless Headphones X on your device.
default: Turn the product off, unplug it or remove the battery for 30 seconds, then turn it on again.
Check every cable and the power source, and try a different outlet or charger.
Reset the product to factory settings using the button described in its quick-start guide.
